description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.8 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Grok Imagine 2.0/Video 1.5 bridges and quota/reset parity (#9013)
- Reuse normalized tools for text recovery (#8950)
- Publish local opt-out catalog status once (#9024)
- Live quota updates for provider account lists (#8993)
Bug Fixes
- Bound context-overflow negation matching (#8980)
- Bound reasoning-effort diagnostic analysis (#8983)
- Recognize Korean disabled and queued task states (#8976)
- Fix misleading CLI output when Codex refuses a desktop settings change (#8929)
- Name the cause of an ownership-unknown native-main fence (#8988)
- Avoid writing an empty initial selection on disconnect (#8989)
- Treat a denied loopback connect like a connect timeout at startup (#8987)
- Preserve moderation category boundaries in a single scan (#8978)
- Enforce Windows stop evidence and deadline boundaries (#8931)
- Query the named task within the stop deadline (#8974)
- Report which stage blocked an update (#8975)
- Explain recovery from terminal startup readiness failure (#9025)
- Accept dated preview versions with a publication attempt (#8977)
- Verify recorded installations before probing (#8981)
- Recognize Japanese Task Scheduler states (#8959)
- Cache the GPT-6.2 system prompt on Codex login (#9019)
- Check codec dimensions before image enlargement (#8979)
- Show Anthropic account verification guidance (#8956)
- Use confirmed roster capabilities for built-in native models (#8898)
- Hop past a provider 413, keep proxy-owned 413s terminal (#9017) (#9021)
Documentation
- Document Claude Code MCP setup and reply checks (#8949)
- Repair the structure budget and Spanish messaging parity on dev (#9028)
Chores
- Align isolated route tests with their child deadline (#8984)
- Reduce npm startup cost in Codex apply fixtures (#8982)
- Use the system BSD stat in the Darwin trust fixture (#9030)
- Raise the Windows shard timeout to 40 minutes (#9033)
